comparison.objective: Press a copper tube into two self-closing clamps until both reach their second locking click.
comparison.physical_skill: Align a long tube simultaneously with two clamp mouths and apply insertion force through two detents versus fine rotary adjustment and tool use.
comparison.success_condition: Requires both clamps locked, tube seated straight, hands clear, and one-second stillness; no iterative damping measurement. Rubric is complete, while click forces are disclosed approximations.
comparison.reason: This tests long-part alignment and snap-fit insertion, not commissioning an adjustable energy absorber.
